description: This PHP test class `EmployeeTimesheetAPITest` is part of the test suite for the `EmployeeTimesheetAPI` within the OrangeHRM Time API module. It contains unit tests and integration tests for creating, retrieving, and updating employee timesheets, and also includes tests for not implemented methods like getOne, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class verifying the functionality of the EmployeeTimesheetAPI, including creation, retrieval, update, and ensuring unimplemented methods throw exceptions.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the creation of employee timesheet entries via the API.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create test method.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of all employee timesheet entries.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll test method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the updating of employee timesheet entries.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the update test method.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that calling getOne on EmployeeTimesheetAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for getOne throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling delete on EmployeeTimesheetAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that getting validation rules for delete throws a not implemented exception.
